# Add to app/Models/User.php (generated by Breeze)

Breeze already creates `app/Models/User.php` — don't replace it, just add these
relationship methods inside the class:

```php
public function subscriptions()
{
    return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\Subscription::class);
}

public function paymentMethods()
{
    return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\PaymentMethod::class);
}

public function invoices()
{
    return $this->hasMany(\App\Models\Invoice::class);
}
```
